headword: {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}

definitions.explanation: The long-term increase in Earth's average temperature due to greenhouse gas emissions. A major topic in news and environmental discussions.

examples.japanese: {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}が{進|すす}んでいる。
{地球|ちきゅう}{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}の{影響|えいきょう}で{海面|かいめん}が{上昇|じょうしょう}している。
examples.english: Sea levels are rising due to the effects of global warming.

examples.japanese: {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}を{食|く}い{止|と}めるために、{二酸化|にさんか}{炭素|たんそ}の{排出量|はいしゅつりょう}を{減|へ}らす{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: To stop global warming, we need to reduce carbon dioxide emissions.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard term in news, environmental science, and policy discussions. Frequently appears in newspaper articles and school textbooks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}が{進|すす}む (global warming progresses)
- {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}の{影響|えいきょう} (effects of global warming)
- {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}を{防|ふせ}ぐ (to prevent global warming)
- {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}{対策|たいさく} (global warming countermeasures)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {気候|きこう}{変動|へんどう}: climate change — broader term encompassing all types of climate shifts, not just warming
- {温室|おんしつ}{効果|こうか}: greenhouse effect — the mechanism behind warming, not the warming itself
